truth_standard: Defined means the requirement and stable trait identity exist.
Executable means runnable implementation code exists.
Tested means functional tests passed against the implementation.
Seeded means a verified built seed artifact contains the capability.
Booted means that verified seed booted with the capability present.
Used means a physical user-facing operation was proven on an authorized machine.

overall.plain: The seven everyday human capabilities now have executable Generation-0 runtimes and functional tests. Fresh seed-artifact, boot, and physical-use proofs are still pending.
overall.human_action: None right now. The next gates are automated build and verification work.

human_capabilities.name: Web browsing
human_capabilities.current: Browser-launch runtime and provider selection are implemented and tested. Firefox ESR is wired into the PC seed definition, but a fresh verified seed artifact has not yet been recorded.
human_capabilities.next: Build the updated PC seed, inspect the artifact, boot it, and prove a webpage opens.

human_capabilities.name: Garden / Files
human_capabilities.current: Garden materialization creates Documents, Photos, Music, Videos, Downloads, Projects, and Shared plots. PCManFM compatibility is wired into the PC seed definition; fresh seed proof is pending.
human_capabilities.next: Verify Garden inside a built seed, boot it, and open/save a real human file.

human_capabilities.name: Music, photos, and video
human_capabilities.current: Unified media launch planning is executable and tested. MPV and audio foundations are wired into the PC seed definition; fresh artifact and playback proof are pending.
human_capabilities.next: Verify the player inside a built seed, boot it, and prove image, audio, and video playback.

human_capabilities.name: Writing and word processing
human_capabilities.current: Document creation and editor launch planning are executable and tested. LibreOffice Writer is wired into the PC seed definition; fresh artifact proof is pending.
human_capabilities.next: Build and boot the updated seed, then create, edit, save, and reopen a document.

human_capabilities.name: Intent and assistance
human_capabilities.current: Everyday language is mapped to stable Aurum trait identities by executable tested code. Seed and shell integration proof remain pending.
human_capabilities.next: Carry the runtime into a verified seed and prove a spoken or typed request opens the intended capability.

human_capabilities.name: Connectivity
human_capabilities.current: Network, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and USB provider probing is executable and tested. Aurum has separate physical connectivity evidence, but the new user-facing trait runtime has not yet received seed/use proof.
human_capabilities.next: Verify the trait inside a fresh seed and exercise network, USB, and Bluetooth through the human surface.

human_capabilities.name: Recovery
human_capabilities.current: Read-only known-good and rollback inspection is executable and tested. Aurum has strong underlying recovery evidence, but the new user-facing recovery trait has not yet been proven inside a fresh seed.
human_capabilities.next: Embed and boot the trait, then prove a safe user-visible diagnosis and rollback path.

system_milestones.name: Executable human-trait runtime
system_milestones.detail: Runtime, functional tests, seven parallel bundle builds, and complete seed payload assembly exist on main.

system_milestones.name: PC seed integration definition
system_milestones.detail: The active PC seed branch includes Firefox ESR, PCManFM, MPV, LibreOffice Writer, Xorg/Openbox, Garden, and all seven trait bundles.

system_milestones.name: Pi seed integration definition
system_milestones.detail: The bounded Pi reconciliation path deploys and tests all seven bundles over the pretrusted USB-C SSH carrier with rollback and no new persistence.

system_milestones.name: Previous physical seed proofs
system_milestones.detail: PC-01 FLASH_OK and Pi4 PI4_SEED_OK prove the older seed paths, not the newly integrated human capabilities.

recent_updates: Implemented executable Aurum human trait runtime.
Replaced contract-only trait lanes with artifact-producing parallel builds.
Embedded runnable human capabilities into the active PC seed definition.
Wired bounded human-trait deployment into Pi seed reconciliation.
Added guards preventing contract-only builds from being reported as implementation progress.
